remarks: Welcome to 71 Aiken Street, Norwalk, CT 06851! This inviting 2-bedroom, 1.5-bathroom condo is located in the desirable Winnipauk Village community, offering a perfect blend of comfort and convenience.  The spacious living area features a cozy fireplace and sliding doors leading to a private balcony overlooking lush greenery-a perfect spot to relax and unwind. The kitchen is equipped with stainless steel appliances, providing a modern touch, while central air ensures year-round comfort.  Upstairs, you'll find two generously sized bedrooms and a full bathroom, along with the convenience of an in-unit washer and dryer. Winnipauk Village offers fantastic amenities, including two pools, a fitness center, and tennis courts. Plus, the community is pet-friendly, making it a great home for you and your furry companions. Conveniently located near major highways, shopping centers, and top dining spots, this condo is a must-see! Don't miss out-schedule a showing starting thursday 4/3/2025!
